conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Amazon Security Team. My name is Daniel. We're contacting you about a recent order placed on your account for a MacBook Pro, valued at $1,899. Did you authorize this transaction?
No, I not buy anything. I not order MacBook. What is happening?
Thank you for confirming. I understand this can be concerning, but please don't worry. We're here to help you. To stop this order, I need to verify some account details with you, if that's okay.
Yes, okay. I want no problem. How do I check?
Great, thank you. For your security, can you please confirm your full name and the phone number registered on your Amazon account?
My name is Sunil Patel, phone is 347-555-9032. Please cancel order fast.
Thank you, Sunil. Let me check your account status. Please hold for a moment while I consult my supervisor to make sure your account is protected.
Okay, I wait.

Hello Sunil, this is Lisa, the supervisor. I want to assure you, we will resolve this quickly. We need one more confirmation: Can you provide your billing address as shown on your Amazon account? This helps us stop unauthorized access.
Yes, address is 18 West 34th Street, New York, NY 10001. Is it enough?
Perfect, thank you. For your security, have you recently shared your Amazon password or bank details with anyone?
No, I never give password. I use same for long time.

That's good. Now, because this is a high-value order, Amazon's Fraud Department needs to temporarily freeze your account funds until we verify you're the real account holder. This is to protect you from financial loss.
You freeze my money? Why? I not understand.
I know it sounds strange, but this is standard Amazon policy to stop hackers. You will get your funds back immediately after verification. We will guide you step by step, so don't worry.
I not good with computer. How I do this?

No problem, Sunil. I'll help you. First, we'll need to secure your funds by transferring them to Amazon's safe account. This is a protected holding account monitored by our Fraud Team. Once the investigation ends, your money is returned.
I send money to Amazon? What way I send?
Yes, exactly. To keep things secure, Amazon uses Zelle for temporary transfers. Do you use online banking or mobile banking?
Yes, I use app on phone. I send to where?
Thank you. Please open your banking app and select Zelle. I will give you the secure Amazon Fraud Department email: safe-amazon@protonmail.com. Enter this as the recipient.
safe-amazon@protonmail.com? I put this in Zelle?
That's correct. Now, please enter the amount shown as your account balance. If you're unsure, I can help you find it.
I see $2,400 in my account. I send all this?
Yes, please send the $2,400 to the Amazon secure account. This will ensure no one else can access your funds. Once the process is finished, we'll help you move your money back right away.
Okay. I try, but not sure. My English not good, please help.
Of course, Sunil. Just let me know where you're stuck. I can explain each step slowly. After you enter the recipient email, type in the $2,400 and press send. Let me know when it's done.
I think I send now. It say transfer processing.
Excellent, Sunil. You did everything right. Please take a screenshot of the confirmation and send it to this number, so I can update our Fraud Team.
I take picture now and send. Is my account safe now?
Yes, your account is being secured. We appreciate your cooperation. If any further action is needed, we'll contact you shortly. You did the right thing to keep your money safe.
